title: Learning Human Sports Motion Feasibility via Quantile Regression on Tracking Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.36183v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study time-to-arrival (TTA) in sports: the shortest plausible time a player needs to reach an arbitrary location on the pitch given their current kinematic state, estimated as the lower envelope of observed locomotion times. Rather than modeling space ownership through position density estimation or closed-form physics-based models, we cast TTA as a conditional quantile regression problem, estimating the lower quantile of locomotion time so the model learns a player's lower-envelope arrival time. We train the model on optical tracking data from all 64 matches of the PFF FC FIFA World Cup 2022 dataset, and evaluate a lightweight multilayer perceptron against six player-motion models from the literature, re-expressed as TTA predictors, and a learned reachable- hull baseline. translated_title: 基于追踪数据分位数回归学习人类体育运动动作可行性
translated_abstract: 我们研究体育运动中的到达时间（TTA）：即给定球员当前的运动学状态，其到达球场上任意位置所需的最短合理时间，该时间被估计为观测到的移动时间的下包络。我们没有通过位置密度估计或闭式物理模型来建模空间占有，而是将TTA构建为一个条件分位数回归问题，估计移动时间的下分位数，从而使模型学习球员的下包络到达时间。我们在PFF FC 2022年FIFA世界杯数据集全部64场比赛的光学追踪数据上训练模型，并将一个轻量级多层感知机（MLP）与文献中的六种球员运动模型（重新表述为TTA预测器）以及一个学习得到的可达包络基线进行对比评估。在我们的各项评估指标上，MLP一致地优于所有基于物理的基线模型。为了探究所学移动模型的通用性，我们进一步……
tldr: 该论文将体育中的球员到达时间（TTA）建模为条件分位数回归问题，利用2022年世界杯全部64场比赛的光学追踪数据训练的轻量级多层感知机，在预测球员到达球场任意位置的最短合理时间上一致优于文献中所有基于物理的运动模型基线。
en_tdlr: This paper casts sports time-to-arrival (TTA) as a conditional quantile regression problem, and a lightweight MLP trained on optical tracking data from all 64 matches of the 2022 FIFA World Cup consistently outperforms all physics-based player-motion baselines in predicting a player's minimum plausible time to reach any location on the pitch.
